item.title: Contact MELBZ
item.description:
Contact MELBZ

Got a tip? Want to list your business? Need to tell us we’re wrong about your suburb? We read every email.

General Enquiries

Email: hq@melbz.com.au

For all general enquiries, partnerships, editorial questions, or just to say g’day — this is the best way to reach us. We aim to respond within 24-48 hours.

Business Listings & Advertising

Want your venue, business, or service featured on MELBZ?

Email: hq@melbz.com.au
Subject line: Business Listing — [Your Business Name]
